sentInvitations.subject: Leadership Appointment: Invitation to Serve as Editor-in-Chief for Scholarly Open: Medicine
sentInvitations.body:
Scholarly Open: Medicine
Peer-Reviewed Journal

Dear Prof. Francis Verpoort,

Based on our recent conversation and your expression of interest, the Executive Editorial Board of Scholarly Open is pleased to invite you to serve as a visionary academic leader as Editor-in-Chief (EiC) of Scholarly Open: Chemistry.

Given your distinguished track record at Independent Scholar and international recognition in Chemistry, we have selected you as a leading candidate for this pivotal leadership post.

As Editor-in-Chief, you will guide the strategic and editorial direction of the journal.
Key responsibilities include:
• Overseeing the peer-review process and making final decisions on manuscript acceptance.
• Collaborating with the internal editorial office to uphold strict ethical standards and COPE academic integrity.
• Leading journal development initiatives, special issues, and strategic scope expansion.
• Serving as the primary ambassador for the journal within the academic community.
• Encouraging high-quality submissions through academic and professional networks (online/offline) and contributing your own scholarly work where appropriate.

Term & Benefits:
• Initial 2-year renewable appointment.
• 25% discount on Article Processing Charges (APCs) for your own submissions.
• Full academic independence and permanent recognition on the journal masthead and web registry.
• Receive a performance-based honorarium for each handled article (for more information, see the link: https://www.scholarlyopen.org/peer-review).

1. Accept (Yes): Confirm your acceptance using the button below.

3. Decline (No) / Suggestions: If you cannot accept at this time, we would greatly appreciate your recommendation of an esteemed colleague.

Sincerely,
Noor F.

sentInvitations.body:
Scholarly Open: Chemistry
Peer-Reviewed Journal

Dear Dr. Francesco Cacciola,

Scholarly Open: Chemistry is expanding its editorial leadership to support submission volumes in Chemistry (in the Food Chemistry section). We have received your application for the role of Associate Editor and appreciate the detailed overview of your expertise in advanced analytical chromatography, mass spectrometry, and natural product characterization. Your research contributions in food chemistry, metabolomics, and sustainable analytical methodologies are highly relevant to the scope of our journal. In recognition of your authoritative scholarship, we would be delighted to invite you to join us as an Associate Editor.

In this role, you will support the Editor-in-Chief by managing the peer-review process for assigned manuscripts within your domain (approximately 1–2 manuscripts per month).
Key responsibilities include:
• Managing the peer review process, including identifying and inviting qualified reviewers.
• Evaluating reviewer reports and formulating detailed editorial recommendations.
• Upholding ethical standards and academic integrity in all decisions.
• Promoting the journal and encouraging high-quality submissions within your network.
• Mentoring Early Career Editorial Board members through transparent co-reviewing.

Term & Benefits:
• Initial 2-year renewable appointment.
• 25% discount on Article Processing Charges (APCs) for your own submissions.
• Full academic independence and official recognition on the journal masthead.
• Receive a performance-based honorarium for each handled article (for more information, see: https://www.scholarlyopen.org/peer-review).

Please let us know if you would be delighted to accept this appointment.

Sincerely,
Noor F.
Editorial Office
